# telnyx_connection_count (Data Source)

The number of connections on the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `counts` (Attributes) Counts of the authenticated user's connections, grouped by connection type. Forward-only connections are excluded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--counts))
- `limits` (String) Connection limits that apply to the user. Contains a single global_limit when a global connection limit applies, or per-type limits (standard_limit, texml_limit and uac_limit) when the user has per-type connection count capabilities. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--counts"></a>

- `mobile_voice_connections` (Number) Number of mobile voice (IMS) connections.
- `operator_connect_connections` (Number) Number of Microsoft Operator Connect connections.
